text: __NOTOC__ Keeshan's Bandana is a quest reward from Triumphant Return.
Keeshan's Burlap Vest was a quest reward from Triumphant Return.
Keeshan's Jade Amulet is a quest item for His Heart Must Be In It.
Keeshan's Possessions is a quest item for They Drew First Blood.
Keeshan's Red Headband is a quest item for His Heart Must Be In It.
Kazit is Boss Mida's personal assistant, located in the Orgrimmar Embassy of Orgrimmar alongside Bruiser Janx and Engineer Niff. He can often be found in conversation with Boss Mida and Janx.
Keetar appears in the Irondeep Mine in Alterac Valley when the Horde has control.

Keg-Shaped Treasure Chests are awarded once-per-day to level + players who use the Dungeon Finder to form a group to kill Coren Direbrew in Blackrock Depths during Brewfest. It will always award 10-15 Brewfest Prize Tokens and a possible chance to get one or multiple of the following:
The Keg of Stormhammer Stout can be found at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Tapping it yields a Cask of Stormhammer Stout.
The Keg of Theramore Pale Ale can be found at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Tapping it yields a Cask of Theramore Pale Ale.
The Keg of Gnomenbrau can be found at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Tapping it yields a Cask of Gnomenbrau.
Keen Ember Topaz requires Jewelcrafting (465) and a Simple Grinder.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Karithus is a keeper of the grove quest giver found in Darkshore.

Kazrali the Witch was a goblin warlock trainer located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar along with her imp. She could be found conversing with Conjurer Mixli. She is not present after the Goblin Slums became the Orgrimmar Embassy.
Keeping it in the Family is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for damaging Nefarian below 50 health before he lands for the final confrontation and then defeat Nefarian in Blackwing Descent.
Keg of Thundermar Ale is a quest item for Fight Like a Wildhammer.
Keg-Stealer Bracers is a quest reward from Fight Like a Wildhammer.

Keeland Doyle was a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon rider whose body can be found in the Obsidian Forest of Twilight Highlands. The Doyle clan was wiped out by the Twilight's Hammer, but before he died Keeland sent his brother Tak away on his own gryphon. Tak would end up in Kul Tiras.

Kedehern Falamar was the son of Brogan and brother of Aodhan. He chose to become a paladin of the Silver Hand, something his father approved of, ten years before the start of the Nexus War. Two years after obtaining the rank, Kedehern died during a battle at the borders of Quel'Thalas against forest troll warbands raiding settlements. His Silver Hand masters brought Kedehern's armor back to his father, and he was considered a hero.

Keeper Taldros is a Keeper of the Grove at Whistling Grove in Mount Hyjal. After the area was saved from the fire he can be found at Sanctuary of Malorne during Firelands invasion and later in the Molten Front where he helps the Shadow Wardens take the Forlorn Spire.
Keeper Krothis is an elite Keeper of the Grove found at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.
Kelbnar is a hell hound occasionally found at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal. He's one of the four fiery lords that can appear here.
Keensnout Potbelly are boars that acts as guard-dogs at Gallywix's Villa in Kezan. They are accompanied by a Villa Mook and are to be avoided during Waltz Right In.

Kazz Fetchum is a goblin stable master located in the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands. Oddly enough, he uses the old Goblin voices (Commonly seen in use by the Steamwheedle Cartel goblins) rather than the new ones often used by the goblins of the Bilgewater Cartel.
Keeper Heartwise is a Keeper of the Grove located at Lake Falathim in Ashenvale.

Kelaan is a Broken located next to Father Gavin along with Lowan Featherbreeze in Misty Pine Refuge in Dun Morogh. Judging by the short conversation the three are having, Featherbreeze and Kelaan appear to have been sent by someone to survey the damage done to Azeroth by the Cataclysm.

__NOTOC__ Kela Grimtotem is a master pet tamer located on Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles. She is surrounded by her three battle pets: Plague, Indigon, and Cho'guana. Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Kalimdor and Taming Azeroth achievements.
Keith "The Party" Westin is a human found in Bizmo's Brawlpub underneath the Deeprun Tram.
Kazmo is a direhorn being raised by the Kirin Tor Offensive, located at their base Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.
Kazemde is a tol'vir innkeeper located at the Ramkahen in Uldum.

Keep those Bombs Away! (From Me) is a scenario achievement. Throughout the scenario, cannon fire targets players which is shown as large red circles on the decks of the ships. Players must avoid being hit at any point during the scenario to earn this achievement.
Keep Rollin' Rollin' Rollin is an achievement earned for killing Ook-Ook after assaulting him with 20 Rolling Brew Barrels in Stormstout Brewery on heroic difficulty.
Keith Silverstein is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Kelari Featherfoot is a pandaren located at Setting Sun Garrison of Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He starts the quest Roll Club: Serpent's Spine.
Keeping It Rare requires completing 50 of the rare garrison missions.
Keanna was a spy of the Violet Eye sent into Karazhan where was staying up at the guest chambers. Archmage Alturus confirmed her death.

Kaz the Shrieker is the presumed chieftain of the Laughing Skull clan in the alternate timeline's Gorgrond. She can later be recruited as a follower, provided a Lumber Mill has been built in Beastwatch.
Kaz'rik is a mantid located at the Heart of Fear in the Dread Wastes. Talk to him to remove the debuff off the raid.
Kayt Miccoats is a gnome located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Keelo is a draenei vendor located at the Embaari Village in .
Keema is a draenei located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Keelin Stonekeeper was the daughter of a dwarven innkeeper named Bryher. She traveled far from home, eventually developing the kind of reputation that embarrassed her father. Bryher made a deal with a gnome warlock to keep his daughter close to home, resulting in the warlock turning Keelin into a :hearthstone so that she would always return to her father's inn.
Keepers is a rat innkeeper and one of 's companions, located at Breaker's Crown in Gorgrond.
Kazbala is a draenei toy vendor located at the Sha'tari Market District in Talador.
Keeho the Savage is a saberon located at the Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
Kaz'hiki is a jungle troll follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Keeper Irizzoth is a wyrmtongue located at the Violet Hold in Dalaran. He only appears in the non-Assault on Violet Hold version.
Kazzak Guild Run is an achievement earned from defeating Supreme Lord Kazzak in Tanaan Jungle, while in a guild group.
Kayn Sunfury's Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Keith Ferguson is a voice actor who has provided voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Kazzalax, Fujieda's Fury enhances Bloodthirst. It is named after Fujieda.
Kel'danath's Manaflask increases the maximum amount of Ancient Mana a player can carry by 100.
Keen Huntresses are friendly huntresses of several races that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Alliance adventurers.
Kegs of Armor Polish appear in Stormwind Harbor and the Dranosh'ar Blockade for To Be Prepared. Clicking one out gives out the Polished Armor buff.
Kel'danath's Legacy will complete the Arcanist Kel'danath portion of Nightfallen But Not Forgotten.

Keelhaul "Keely" Watt was the youngest member of the Wavestrider crew, being 10 years old. He was the assistant of Jonas Cobb, the ship's cook. After his betrayal, Keely was promoted to the position, even though he wasn't very good at it. Despite his young age, he used a lot of swear words directed at Old Cobb. When the Wavestrider was attacked, Keely, armed with a cutlass, targeted Old Cobb and tried to tire the traitor, or so it seemed to Aram. Once Aram attacked Jonas, Keely, swearing, rushed to join Aram but the former cook heard the approaching boy and stabbed him in the belly, killing him instantly.
Keith Szarabajka is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Kegs of Pirate Ale are found aboard the ships anchored at Southsea Holdfast in Thousand Needles.
The Keg of Booty Bay Rum is sold by Emery Neill in Stratholme in The Deaths of Chromie scenario for .
Keen Felstalker is a felstalker located at the Well of Eternity in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Kel'balor is an underground facility found hidden near the Crimson Thicket in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Raynae is a forest nymph located in Val'sharah.
Keenbean Kafa Co. is a grummle trading company focused on selling Keenbean Kafa.

Kegs of Azerite Powder are barrels of :Azerite found in the waters of Mist's Edge in Darkshore. They are being secured by goblin recovery specialists and Coastal Defenders. Horde adventurers lift them up from the water, while the Alliance ones blow them up.
Keeper's Crescent is a quest reward from The Fall of Emperor Korthek.
Keelson's Bloody Drape is a quest reward from Blood in the Tides.
__NOTOC__ Keeyo is a vulpera pet tamer located at the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun. His pets are Tikka, Buzzbeak, and Milo.
Keeper Korthek is a statue of Korthek located at the west part of the central courtyard in Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun.
Keeper Vorrik is a statue of Vorrik located at the south part of the central courtyard in Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun.
Keeper Sulthis is a statue of Sulthis located at the east part of the central courtyard in Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun.
Kazai is a blood troll outpost in Nazmir on the road to Zo'bal Ruins, between Zalamar and the Terrace of Sorrows. Blood Witch Najima is performing blood rituals in the swamp.

:A keg filled to the brim with the strongest drink available this side of Khaz Modan! A Keg of Thunderwater was required by Chen Stormstout during the Founding of Durotar. It was sold at Aicila's Marketplace.

__NOTOC__ Keerin is a vulpera found locked inside a cage at the Ashvane Encampment in Vol'dun. He's tried to bargain for his release, but the Ashvane forces have refused all of his offers. He asks adventurers to gather keys from the Ashvane forces in the area so that he may go free. However, as none of the keys fit, he then sends adventurers into the Redrock Mines to take Overseer Morrison's master key, use it to free the vulpera captives in the mine, and finally unlock his cage, after which he runs off and disappears, never to be seen again.

Kaza'jin the Wavebinder is a Zandalari troll located at Warport Rastari in Zuldazar and in Dazar'alor. As a wavebinder, it is through him that the loa bless the Zandalari ships, and has a connection to the Other Side and Bwonsamdi. When the Kao-Tien mogu invaded the port, he asked the Horde Speaker to collect his items: bijous, his grimoire, and remains of the fallen, after which he joined Rastakhan's guards. Habutu then gave him Rastari Skull Whistle, and Kaza'jin blessed it with voodoo. The Wavebinder sent the Speaker to use the skull on his Spirit Obelisks in order to summon Vengeful Ancestors from the Other Side. With the enemy forces crippled, Kaza'jin moved further into the port and se
Keena Ferguson is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Keeper Shavras's Core can be found next to the deceased Titan Keeper Shavras in Nazmir.
Keeper Bolcan's Core drops from Titan Keeper Bolcan in Nazmir.

Keeper Dagda is a keeper of the grove located in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore, helping the wisps near Bashal'Aran after the Alliance adventurer captured Cinderfall Grove and inspired them.
__NOTOC__ Kel'vax Brutes are dire troll zombies located in Nazmir.
Kel'vax Skeleton Shapers are skeletal trolls located in Nazmir.
Kel'vax Offerings are deceased blood trolls located in Nazmir.
Kel'vax's Splintered Phylactery would be rewarded from Hunt the Hunter.
Keanna's Will would have been the reward from the following quests: *A Well Rounded Defense *Healing Amplification *Lethality First
The Keg of Grog may refer to: *Keg of Grog (Gorgrond) *Keg of Grog (Stormheim) *Keg of Grog (Tiragarde Sound)
The Keelbreak Girdle is a reputation reward; you must be with Storm's Wake to purchase this item from Sister Lilyana in Stormsong Valley for .
Kelfin Captives are gilgoblins located in Zanj'ir Wash in Nazjatar. Some are held in cages.
Kelfin Scouts are gilgoblins riding on his golden snapdragon in Ashen Strand and Zanj'ir Wash in Nazjatar. They are seen in pairs or with a Unshackled Protector.
Kazoa is a Zandalari troll who ferries passangers for the voyages offered by Wavesinger Zara in Zuldazar. He attended the funeral of King Rastakhan in Dazar'alor.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Vardan is a worgen located in the Battle for Darkshore.
Kelfin Wranglers are gilgoblins located in the Brinestone Cove in Nazjatar. They oversee Scale Lord Theronar.
The Keg of Applebrew was to be an objective of Raiding Their Stores.
Kaymon appears to have been a Zandalari troll. His plaque can be found in the chamber where Gee'dae the Cursed is trying to corrupt Valjabu; inside the Necropolis Catacombs in Nazmir.
Kazerin appears to have been a Zandalari troll. His plaque can be found in the chamber where Gee'dae the Cursed is trying to corrupt Valjabu; inside the Necropolis Catacombs in Nazmir.
The Kel'vax's Shrine is a shrine where Kel'vax Deathwalker resides.
Keeper Mnemis is a centurion located at Agthia's Repose in Bastion.
Keep DPS-ing and Nobody Explodes is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by preventing the destruction of all non-robotic life on Azeroth on Mythic difficulty in Operation: Mechagon.
__NOTOC__ Kazak Darkscream is an orc warlock trainer located in the Barracks in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Nokturne is a venthyr located in the Grove of Terror in Revendreth.
Keening Spirits are mogu ghosts summoned by Uruk in Townlong Steppes.
Keeper Xibek is a Zandalari dire troll located in Seawatch Point in Stormsong Valley during Faction Assaults.
Keepers of Worth are broker bankers located in the Hall of Holding in Oribos.

Keeper Ta'saran is a broker stable master located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos. Together with Stablehand Ta'shno they manage beasts being portaled in, stabling them in the Dimensional Storage Cube. During the Feast of Winter Veil, he plays the part of Greatfather Winter for the dredgers in Sinfall.
Keeper Ta'hult is a broker located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos.
Keen Jagged Blade was replaced by Prideful Manacles in the beta.
The Keg of Blast-O Powder drops from Sapper Specialists in Southern Barrens.
Keep Your Wits About You is an Azerite trait available to Outlaw rogues.
Keepsakes of the First Conflict are looted from chests in Maldraxxus.
The Keen Marshfang Shanker is a quest reward from Lines of Communication (Zangarmarsh) and The Sharpest Blades.
Keleseth's Influencer drops from Prince Keleseth at the southern end of Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown during Death Rising.

Keg-Shaped Treasure Box drops from Coren Direbrew during Brewfest once a day for players who have not reached level 110. For level 110-and-above players, he drops the Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest instead. The only difference between the two items is that this one will not contain the mounts.
Keeper Ta'hilt is a broker located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos.
Keeneye Brigadiers are worgen located in Bashal'Aran in Darkshore during In Darkest Night.
Kee is a tortollan located in northern Exile's Reach. She is found in a secret underwater cave under a waterfall.
Keen-Eyed Sentries are Maldraxxi gladiators located in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Kayt Fregosa is a gladiator located in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.

The Keepsake Chest appears when Alexstrasza conjures it for Night Fae players on the campaign quest A Token of Lost Love at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands. It contains A Small Carving of Ysera.

Keeper's Respite is the quest hub of Korthia. A PvP sanctuary, players unlock the respite, and the rest of Korthia, early in the second chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign. A Waystone to Oribos is present, and it drops players off at the northwest corner of the Ring of Transference in Oribos. The area is bordered by the Maw to the north, the edge of the zone to the east, the Scholar's Den to the south, and the Sanctuary of Guidance to the west. The entrance to the Reliquary of Remembrance is found at by the Night Fae area.
The Keen-Eyed Gronnstalker is an orc located at the Pits of Mannoroth in .

__NOTOC__ Keeper Hazaduum is the boss Mawsworn construct of the "Ossuary of the Banished" wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Hazaduum needs to die during the Chains of Domination campaign quest A Paladin's Soul for players to recover Uther's soul fragment.
The Keeper's Respite Defense Report is obtained by talking to Nadjia the Mistblade at the Keeper's Respite in Korthia.
Kazj The Sentinel is a Mawsworn construct located in the Maw as a boss of a Tormentors of Torghast event.
Keensnout Gromits are gromits located in northeastern Korthia, mainly along the road between Keeper's Respite and the Sanctuary of Guidance.
Keeneye Bowmen are Maldraxxi skeletons sent from the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus to the Temple of Courage in Bastion.
Kazj's Stygian Splitter drops from Kazj The Sentinel in The Maw.
Keepcrawler's Gutripper is sold by the following vendors for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Sparklebreeze *Adera *Harkoth *Sulanoom
Keen Skinning Knife might have been intended for use on Tiragarde Skyhunters.

Kea'ton is a draenei who acted as an escort to Ambassador Zekhan and pathfinder Rexxar on the Azuremyst Isles after the Fourth War. The draenei guided them through the Exodar and the areas of the isle, revealing information about the places they visited, problems that were present, as well about the naaru that helped them in the past and about the local satyrs.
Kein the Disgraced is a Maldraxxi skeleton. Kein's Runeblade likely belonged to him.
Keeper's Iron Grips drop from Emberon in Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr.
Keen Skywatchers are proto-dragons located at the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.
Keese Featherhoof is a tauren located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. They are found with a few other druids: Chumbergo, Gyasi Ra'lar and Aona Kaseldri.
Keeper's Glory is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (40); taught by Design: Keeper's Glory.
Keen Ysemerald is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (30); taught by Design: Keen Ysemerald.
Keen Neltharite is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (30); taught by Design: Keen Neltharite.
__NOTOC__ Kazra is a bronze drakonid found in central Valdrakken. She is surrounded by her three biggest fans: Allik, Yikko and Raxem.
Keenu is a tuskarr located in the Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken.
Kazoo is a house cat located with Barley in an otherwise empty house in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken.
Kazzi is a furbolg quartermaster of the Winterpelt Furbolg found Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span. Players are introduced to her during the Local Flavors quest.
Keen Competitors are niffen located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
Kazure is a dracthyr located in Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken.
Kazzara's Grafted Companion drops from Kazzara, the Hellforged in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Keeper Amrymn is a keeper of the grove located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
Keeper Sillas is a keeper of the grove found in the Haven Cascades in the Emerald Dream.
"Kek" is what was displayed to Alliance characters when a Horde character says "lol" in Orcish. The word has since entered greater gaming and even real-world political vernacular.
Khadgar's Whisker is an herb that can be gathered with herbalism (160).

Khan is the centaur word for a chieftain who leads one of the centaur clans or tribes. The title is used by both Kalimdor's centaur and the Maruuk. Among Kalimdorian centaur, the title is placed before the name (e.g. Khan Shodo), whereas among the Maruuk, it is placed after (e.g. Sansok Khan). The foremost khan among the Maruuk is the Khanam Matra of Clan Teerai, who acts as the cultural khan of all Maruuk clans and is protected by the khansguard. The first khans of Kalimdor's centaur were the first five children of Zaetar and Princess Theradras. Kalimdorian khans can have their own guards and advisors, and their sons may help them rule. Most clans only have one khan at a time, but the Galak
Keras Wolfheart was a human Arathi Basin battlemaster located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus during the Call to Arms: Arathi Basin.

__NOTOC__ Keyl Swiftclaw is a night elf quest giver located just outside the entrance to Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj in Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom. He is a cloak crafter and can create special cloaks from items in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Before the Cataclysm he was located at Cenarion Hold.
__NOTOC__ Ken'jai was a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
:"The Warsong Outriders will not back down!" Kelm Hargunth is an orc PvP rewards vendor located at Mor'shan Base Camp in the Northern Barrens. He is the supply officer for the Warsong Outriders.
Ken'zigla's Draught is the 5th quest in the Devourer of Souls quest chain.
Kennah Hawkseye is a tauren gun vendor located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

Kernobee was a goblin quest giver found unconscious in a small room off the far (west) side (opposite the Clean Zone) of the Dormitory area of Gnomeregan. His room was on the bottom row, the 2nd doorway from the left (north) wall. When he found out about the involvement of the Dark Iron dwarves in the making of the super rig, Kernobee wanted to get out of Gnomeregan and report to Tinkerwiz in Ratchet as soon as possible. He got caught by the Dark Irons and thrown into the Dormitory to die among the stinking troggs. Adventurers could escort him out of Gnomeregan.

Kelsuwa is a tauren former stable master formerly located in Camp Taurajo in the Horde-aligned territory of the Barrens. Along with the other survivors of the Alliance attack on Camp Taurajo, he currently resides in Camp Una'fe in what is now the Southern Barrens. He no longer performs any services.
Kentic Amice is a pair of Level 47 quality Cloth Shoulderpads that improve Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Keli'dan the Breaker, the fel orc jailor of Magtheridon, is the final boss in the Blood Furnace wing of Hellfire Citadel.
Kernda is a furbolg quest ender located in Timbermaw Hold in Felwood. Killing him makes you lose 75 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.
Kellag is a draenei banker located at the Seat of the Naaru in the Exodar. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
__NOTOC__ Kessel is a draenei quest giver located at Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle. Kessel is one of the many who journey to Blood Watch to celebrate the hero of Bloodmyst and Azuremyst.
The Key of Time unlocks Heroic Mode key for the Caverns of Time instances: *Escape from Durnholde Keep *Opening the Dark Portal

__NOTOC__ The Key to the Arcatraz was used to access the Arcatraz instance in Tempest Keep. While the key can no longer be earned, players can still ask A'dal for the key if they earned it in the past.
Khadgar's Kilt of Abjuration drops from Temporus in the Black Morass instance of Caverns of Time.
Keris of Zul'Serak is a Level 55 quality Dagger that has a chance on hit to poison it's target, dealing damage and temporarily decreasing it's attack speed.
Khalan is a jungle troll stable master located in Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh.
__NOTOC__ Kerpow Blastwrench is a goblin weapon vendor located at Cosmowrench in the Netherstorm.
Kenata's Head drops from Kenata Dabyrie in the Arathi Highlands.
Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Converence drops from the following bog beasts in the Swamp of Sorrows: * Tangled Horror * Swampwalker Elder * Mire Lord * Molt Thorn * Swampwalker
Kenshin was a resident of Andorhal when Arthas, having just killed his father and betrayed his people, came through and slaughtered Uther and the other Paladins guarding his father's urn.
The Keystone is an obelisk in the Circle of Inner Binding in the Arathi Highlands. This stone is a central part of Myzrael's binding.
Keli'dan's Feathered Stave drops from Keli'dan in Blood Furnace on heroic mode.
Khadgar's Unlocking was a spell for the mage designed to unlock chests and other items, in a similar manner to Lockpicking. It was removed from the beta of World of Warcraft classic.

__NOTOC__ Kerr Ironsight is a Wildhammer dwarf quest giver located at Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in Aerie Peak. Her cousin fought in the Second War.

A malicious and surreptitious method of capturing and recording user keystrokes on a personal computer usually with the intent of enabling account fraud or identity theft by forwarding this information on immediately or at a later time over the network to the controller of the keylogger. This method is not specific to World of Warcraft, but is often used to take over people's accounts without their knowledge. The following types of information are usually gathered for illicit use: * Name, address, or other personal information * Login and password * Credit card, Paypal, or other financial data numbers * Social security or other personal identification numbers
.]] Kennels are a form of stables where hounds and wolves are bred and trained. The terms are rather interchangeable and as such kennels will sometimes just be called stables.
Kenry the Robber is the leader of a party of bandits. He ran afoul of a group of subversives losing many of his people.
Keristrasza was a servant of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, captured by Malygos, who keeps her imprisoned inside the Nexus.

The Key to the Focusing Iris drops from Sapphiron in the 10-man version of Naxxramas. Although it is a quest item, it must be rolled for, meaning only one person in the raid will be able to loot it, receive the quest The Key to the Focusing Iris, and receive an item Level 213 quest reward item for completing the quest Judgment at the Eye of Eternity, which involves getting a raid to kill Malygos.
Khadgar's Silver Coin is fished from the fountain in the Eventide district of Dalaran.

__NOTOC__ Keritose Bloodblade is a Darkfallen death knight and quest giver located at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown. He directs adventurers to figure the defenses at the Weeping Quarry and to fight the Scourge forces in the quarry. After hearing rumors regarding Malykriss: The Vile Hold and Arthas's new death knight order he sends adventurers to speak to Vereth the Cunning to learn about them.

The Key to Refurbished Shredder is obtained upon completing Shredder Repair. You can use the key to get in a Refurbished Shredder in the forest around Venture Bay. The self-destruct hotkey can be used to one shot the elite captains in Venture Bay to complete Down With Captain Zorna! or Crush Captain Brightwater!.
Keristrasza's Broken Heart dropped from Keristrasza in the Nexus on heroic mode.
__NOTOC__ Khaliisi is a blood elf quest giver located in the Storm Peaks. She stands next to her pet, Frostbite.
Kezzik the Striker is goblin vendor that sells vintage Season 1 PvP weapons and armor for Mark of Honor. He can be found in Area 52 in Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Kevin Weaver is a human trade goods vendor found at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
The Key to Vaelen's Chains drops from Instructor Hroegar in Jotunheim in Icecrown.

The Khadgar's Regalia set is the Tier 9 Alliance Mage raid set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets: * Conqueror's Khadgar's Regalia (ilevel 232) *:purchased with Justice Points * Triumphant Khadgar's Regalia (ilevel 245) *: purchased with Justice Points and , from Trial of the Crusader * Triumphant Khadgar's Regalia (heroic) (ilevel 258) *: purchased with , from Trial of the Grand Crusader

The Keys to the Hot Rod are provided as an objective for Rolling with my Homies. They persists after the completion of the quest for use as a mount around Kezan. Using the keys puts you into a Hot Rod vehicle.

Kelp'thar Forest is the first zone in the undersea region known as Vashj'ir. It is one of the two starting zone for all players level 80 and higher (the other is Mount Hyjal). The forest features a vast array of aquatic life and plants. There is a mixed focus between the main quests involving the naga and auxiliary quests introducing players to Vashj'ir's new under water mechanics. The most noticeable feature of the Kelp'thar Forest is found along the southern edge of the zone in what is known as the Lightless Reaches.

Loot the chest for Stonegrinder, roughly 60 Garrison Resources, and mint-condition copy of A Steamy Romance Novel: I'm In Love With a Robot (Talador).

Ketya's Hideaway is a well-defended cave on the Orunai Coast east of in northeastern Talador. The cave is guarded by three devices: *Slowing Ward: Reduces movement speed by 75% in areas marked by a red dotted line *Scanner Ward: Fires a beam of energy from the ceiling moving in a 5-yard radius circle around the ward *Sentry Wards: Fires a beam that follows intruders inside the 10-yard radius circle marked with a blue line. The two latter devices, if they hit, will knock off 75% of max health: * The trick is to stay out of the slowing wards at all costs, and run along the outside edge of the sentry ward detection area, getting out of the blue circle before the beam gets too close. Kelgur is the only son of Nokrar and Kagra and would follow her parents, along with her siblings, when they left the clan to join the Horde. However en route they would be attacked and the children would become separated from their parents, but thanks to the timely arrival of the draenei the children would be safely escorted back to the Frostwolves. They later be reunited with their mother when Durotan returned with her, though the children would learn that their father was dead killed by the Redwalkers. After travelling through the to Azeroth with his family, Kelgur was eventually slain by the other orcs of the Horde, following the Frostwolves' meeting with the humans of Stormwind.
